mapper.sql: id, org_id, activity_id, purpose, stored_name, original_name, content_type, size_bytes, uploaded_by, created_at, deleted_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attachment (org_id, activity_id, purpose, stored_name, original_name, content_type, size_bytes, uploaded_by) VALUES (#{orgId}, #{activityId}, #{purpose}, #{storedName}, #{originalName}, #{contentType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{uploadedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM attachment WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT FROM attachment WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE attachment SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
